description: A full-featured WPF hex editor UserControl for .NET 8. View and edit binary files with syntax coloring, format detection, column/row highlighting, undo/redo, search, and 400+ built-in format definitions. Drop-in replacement for WPFHexaEditor 2.x — completely rewritten for performance and modularity.
releaseNotes: 3.3.0 — HexEditorSplitHost (synchronized split-view, standalone-safe); HexEditorSettings auto-generated settings panel; IParsedFieldsPanel integration API (GetByteProvider, FindSelect, ConnectParsedFieldsPanel); themed IdeMessageBox / IDialogService; +10 new localizations (uk-UA, cs-CZ, vi-VN, hu-HU, ro-RO, id-ID, th-TH, el-GR, da-DK, fi-FI); split-view sync + breadcrumb fixes.
title: WPFHexaEditor - WPF Hex Editor UserControl
